deep_dive.title: PULSE: Unlocking Practical Image Compression on Single-Thread CPU
deep_dive.abstract: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, existing methods remain computationally expensive on resource-constrained hardware, particularly CPUs. We introduce PULSE, a practical codec that enables (1) low-latency decoding on diverse hardware platforms with an ultra-low-complexity 5.2 kMAC/pixel neural receiver, and (2) efficient bit-exact entropy coding with an integer linear CDF predictor and a meta prior. To recover compression performance under this tight budget, we introduce an agentic evolution process guided by heuristic probes that iteratively improves the architecture through human-LLM collaboration. PULSE decodes a 1080p image in 126 ms on a single CPU thread while achieving compression performance comparable to HM. After perceptual optimization, PULSE competes with larger perceptual codecs like MS-ILLM. Codes are at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对学习式图像压缩在CPU等资源受限硬件上计算开销过大、难以落地的问题，本文提出实用编解码器PULSE。它采用仅5.2 kMAC/像素的超低复杂度神经接收器，并结合整数线性CDF预测器与元先验实现比特精确熵编码，还借助启发式探针引导的智能体演化优化网络结构。实验表明其在单CPU线程上126毫秒解码1080p图像，压缩性能可与HM相当，为端侧低复杂度神经编解码提供了可行方案。

quick_skim.title: Successive Refinement Under Strong-Sense Perfect Perception
quick_skim.abstract: We revisit a multiterminal lossy source coding problem named successive refinement and derive the rate-distortion-perception region under the strong-sense perfect perception constraint in the presence of unlimited common randomness. Specifically, in successive refinement, one aims to compress a source sequence and allows two distinct decoders to recover the source sequence at different distortion levels. By imposing the strong-sense perfect perception constraint, our results refine the previous result by analyzing the impact of the perceptual quality. Our achievability proof is inspired by output constrained lossy source coding and our converse proof adapts the proof steps of the standard successive refinement problem. Furthermore, we provide a numerical example of the Bernoulli source to illustrate our result and show that the Bernoulli source under Hamming distortion is successively refinable even with the strong-sense perfect perception constraint.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对逐次细化问题中感知质量对率失真区域影响不清的不足，本文重新审视多端有损信源编码。作者在无限公共随机性下推导强意义完美感知约束下的率失真感知区域，给出可达性与逆定理证明，并提供数值示例。结果细化了既有结论并揭示感知质量的作用，为生成式视频编码中的感知率失真优化提供理论参考。
